Serbian tennis player Novak Djokovic recited the "Our Father" prayer at the main temple of Hilandar Monastery on Mount Athos. The video was filmed by monk Milutin Hilandarak. Hilandar is one of the oldest Orthodox monasteries on Athos and a key Serbian shrine. Djokovic attended with his father Srdjan and uncle Goran, participating in a festive service honouring King Milutin. Djokovic openly professes the Orthodox faith, emphasising that he considers himself primarily an Orthodox Christian before being an athlete. @Slavyangrad

🎮 🇺🇸 A US Army battalion offered soldiers four days off to play Grand Theft Auto VI if they reenlisted, and it worked. The 9th Brigade Engineer Battalion at Fort Stewart, Georgia, promised eligible soldiers four days off to play the game from November 20 to 23, right after its launch. The deal was open to soldiers who signed up for another two to six years. So far, 43 members of the battalion have taken the offer, out of 130 who were eligible. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics

Dhaka Police have reportedly picked up Hindu actress Jyotika Jyoti from her Uttara home in the early hours.
